texts.zh:
我们对克兰尼克斯恒星系进行的初步扫描显示，巴洛瑞兹已经被核武器所摧毁。居民们使用了威力强大的星球级武器相互毁灭，甚至连卫星都被震碎了。

我们想要知道发生了什么，就只能通过目前还在恒星系中巡航的一艘舰船，但它正在用导弹攻击我们。
texts.en:
Our initial scan of the Xraneax system revealed that the planet Baloryz was destroyed by nuclear weapons. The inhabitants annihilated themselves using planet-based weapons so powerful that they even shattered their moon.

Our only chance to learn more about what happened is a ship patrolling the system, but it is already targeting us with its missiles.
